query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park near the community center, he had so much fun chasing frisbees that he ended up covered in mud, and I had to give him three baths when we got home just to get all the dirt out of his fur. I also tried that new matcha boba shop downtown yesterday, the taro topping was way sweeter than I expected, I ended up having to ask them to add extra ice to dilute the sweetness a bit. Hey, I'm currently abroad and my roaming is off, and I've been having issues with my mobile network lately. My airplane mode is on, my data mode is also off, I already exceeded my data usage limit, my network preference settings are all messed up, my APN MMS settings are broken, and the two required permissions for my mobile data app are disabled too, can you help me figure out what's going on?
